The '''Mon Tondievz Mine''' was a [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystal]] [[Mining/Legends|mine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Krann]]. The [[Mon Tondievz, Ltd.]] company were in charge of the mine. It was located near [[Mon Tondievz City]].
